quests.title: Second Breath
quests.summary: Orient yourself after an unexplained Recall/Collector reconstruction and decide what Sol's help means.

stages.title: Second Breath
stages.objective: Speak with Sol beside the damaged Recall/Collector.
stages.directive: Find out who kept the Collector working—and what he expects in return.
stages.why: Sol is your first connection to Sprawl 15, but needing his help does not surrender your right to question or refuse him.

actions.label: Accept the favor
actions.summary: Take Sol's help at face value for now.
actions.result_text: You accept the favor. Sol's relief is genuine, but he never says why the Collector was worth saving.

actions.label: Demand the missing truth
actions.summary: Press Sol on why the Collector rebuilt enough of you to move before agreeing to continue.
actions.result_text: You demand an answer. Sol admits the Collector intercepted you rather than finding you, then ends the explanation there.

actions.label: Refuse the debt
actions.summary: Acknowledge that Sol kept the Collector working without granting him authority over what comes next.
actions.result_text: You refuse the debt. Sol's smile thins, but he gives you the location anyway: he needs the medicine more than he needs obedience.

quests.title: Borrowed Medicine
quests.summary: Recover a disputed medical case, prove your class identity through action, and decide who receives a scarce resource.

stages.title: Borrowed Medicine
stages.objective: Recover the sealed clinic case from Salvage Row. Sol and Mara can each explain their claim.
stages.directive: Find the disputed medical case before its cold seal fails.
stages.why: The case can keep the Collector running or reopen Mara’s clinic. Learning who moved it will change what your choice means.

event_transitions.result_text: The case's cold lattice stutters in your hands. Something in your training returns before the rest of your memory.

stages.title: Proof of Life
stages.objective: Use your class instinct to stabilize the handoff before deciding who receives the medicine.
stages.directive: Act on the skill that returned with you.
stages.why: Your class is the first reliable part of yourself the Collector restored; it does not decide your allegiance.
stages.room_hint: Any safe room while carrying the sealed clinic case

actions.label: Recover your class instinct
actions.summary: Let your selected class shape how you solve the immediate problem.
actions.result_text: A buried pattern returns and becomes deliberate action.

chosen_one.label: Burn through the feedback
chosen_one.summary: Force the failing seal closed while your body regenerates through the strain.
chosen_one.result_text: Power surges through your arms. You clamp the failing seal until the cold lattice steadies, then feel the pain already beginning to recede.

messenger.label: Hold the line
messenger.summary: Plant yourself between the claimants and control the space around the case.
messenger.result_text: You anchor the handoff point and redirect every reaching hand. The crowd reorganizes around your presence without realizing you commanded it.

boss.label: Negotiate from leverage
boss.summary: Read who actually controls the market and make the case too costly to seize.
boss.result_text: You name the debts, witnesses, and future favors attached to the case. The nearest opportunists decide that taking it from you would cost more than it is worth.

fixer.label: Rebalance the compounds
fixer.summary: Identify which medicines can be separated without ruining the whole case.
fixer.result_text: You read the dose codes and isolate compatible compounds. What looked indivisible can serve more than one patient—if handled carefully.

zealot.label: Make the claim public
zealot.summary: Commit to a principle and force every witness to acknowledge the stakes.
zealot.result_text: You raise the case where the market can see it and declare that hidden ownership ends here. The challenge in your voice turns a theft into a public judgment.

devout.label: Craft field doses
devout.summary: Use scrap filters and clean cloth to preserve more of the medicine.
devout.result_text: You turn market scraps into sterile dose wraps and stabilize the weakest vials. Faith becomes careful hands rather than a speech.

protector.label: Shield the handoff
protector.summary: Take the dangerous side of the exchange and protect the clinic runner.
protector.result_text: You place your body between the case and the threat line. The clinic runner moves because you make the dangerous space yours.

guide.label: Triage the crowd
guide.summary: Restore enough calm to identify who needs the medicine first.
guide.result_text: You turn panic into an ordered triage line. Breathing steadies, voices lower, and the choice becomes about need instead of volume.

system.label: Break the false ownership seal
system.summary: Trace the case lock's machine logic and expose who rewrote it.
system.result_text: You follow the lock's handshake through three forged owners and reveal Mara's buried clinic seal beneath the newest layer.

engineer.label: Repair the cold lattice
engineer.summary: Rebuild the case's failing thermal circuit before the medicine spoils.
engineer.result_text: You bridge a burned trace with clean wire and reset the lattice cycle. The warning light falls from red to a steady amber.

infiltrator.label: Trace the blind route
infiltrator.summary: Map the camera gaps and identify how the case changed hands.
infiltrator.result_text: You reconstruct the handoff from wet footprints, rotated cameras, and one careless reflection. Someone planned the theft—and someone else watched it.

sniper.label: Find the unseen observer
sniper.summary: Use sightlines, rain movement, and reflections to locate the watcher.
sniper.result_text: You stop looking at the case and study the angles around it. A distant lens withdraws from the only position that could see every claimant.

born_assassin.label: Break the extortion line
born_assassin.summary: End the immediate threat without turning the market into a slaughterhouse.
born_assassin.result_text: You cross the distance before the loudest threat finishes speaking and leave them pinned, breathing, and unable to reach the case. The rest reconsider.

soldier.label: Secure the handoff
soldier.summary: Establish a corridor, assign positions, and move the case under control.
soldier.result_text: You turn strangers into a temporary detail: watch the east lane, clear the path, protect the case. For a few seconds, chaos obeys structure.

medic.label: Dose by survival need
medic.summary: Triage the medicine against the patients most likely to die without it.
medic.result_text: You read the seals, count the viable doses, and match them to survival need. The case stops being property and becomes a treatment plan.

stages.title: The Cost of Help
stages.objective: Choose what happens to the sealed clinic case.
stages.directive: Decide who controls the medicine—and accept the visible consequence.
stages.why: There is no clean answer. Sol, Mara, and the Rain Market will remember who received the medicine.
stages.room_hint: Speak with Sol or Mara, then choose a method

actions.label: Deliver the full case to Sol
actions.summary: Prioritize the Collector and honor Sol's request exactly.
actions.result_text: Sol takes the case and immediately feeds its cold cells into the Collector. Across the market, Mara lowers the clinic shutter before the waiting line can form.

actions.label: Divide the medicine
actions.summary: Keep the Collector alive and reopen a limited clinic line.
actions.result_text: You divide the viable doses. The Collector receives enough to stay stable, and Mara opens a narrow triage line beneath the orange awning.

actions.label: Expose the false claim
actions.summary: Trace the hidden clinic seal and return the full case to Mara.
actions.result_text: You expose the repainted clinic seal and return the case to Mara in public. A chalk notice names the theft chain before anyone can rewrite it again.

actions.label: Secure an alternate supply
actions.summary: Give Mara the case and use a scavenged patch kit to meet Sol's immediate need.
actions.result_text: You return the case to Mara and rebuild the Collector's failing medical line around a scavenged patch kit. Sol gets survival, not obedience.

stages.title: The Cost of Help
stages.objective: Choose whether your first story-earned training point becomes physical or mental growth.
stages.directive: Make your first progression decision.
stages.why: Choose the growth that fits how you survived. Either path strengthens you without favoring one moral answer.

actions.label: Choose physical growth
actions.summary: Add one physical training point for later rank purchase.
actions.result_text: You choose physical development. The decision becomes one spendable physical training point.

actions.label: Choose mental growth
actions.summary: Add one mental training point for later rank purchase.
actions.result_text: You choose mental development. The decision becomes one spendable mental training point.

quests.title: The Dead Relay
quests.summary: Carry a resonant fragment to a relay that should be dark, then decide what to do with evidence of an unseen observer.

stages.title: The Dead Relay
stages.objective: Reach the Service Tunnel and search the cold conduit for the blue-black fragment.
stages.directive: Find the object that made the Collector answer a dead relay.
stages.why: Fight the masked scavenger or force a way past it. Even defeat returns you to the last safe Recall point.

event_transitions.result_text: The blue-black splinter answers your pulse with a pressure behind the eyes. The relay above is no longer merely a landmark.

stages.title: The Dead Relay
stages.objective: Carry the resonant fragment to the Relay Overlook and interact with the tower.
stages.directive: Let the fragment approach the relay and observe what answers.
stages.why: Seven pulses answer the fragment. The pattern hints at gates and source energy, but its meaning remains hidden.

actions.label: Answer the dead relay
actions.summary: Bring the blue-black fragment close enough to complete the impossible circuit.
actions.result_text: The fragment lifts against gravity. Seven pulses move through the relay foundation—five sharp as returning senses, two too deep to hear. For one breath, rain hangs motionless above the tram cut.

stages.title: Someone Is Watching
stages.objective: Search the Relay Overlook for evidence of the observer who tracked the signal.
stages.directive: Find what the watcher left behind before the rain erases it.
stages.why: The trace links your reconstruction, the Collector, and the relay without revealing who is responsible.

event_transitions.result_text: The observer is gone, but the trace proves the relay test was witnessed. Who learns that fact is now your decision.

stages.title: Someone Is Watching
stages.objective: Decide what to do with the watcher evidence.
stages.directive: Choose who receives the truth—or whether anyone does.
stages.why: Who receives the watcher’s trace will shape trust, leverage, and your control over the truth.

actions.label: Tell Sol
actions.summary: Give the person who operated the damaged Collector the warning immediately.
actions.result_text: You tell Sol exactly what the relay revealed and what the watcher left behind. He thanks you too quickly, then asks a question you never answered aloud.

actions.label: Hide the evidence
actions.summary: Keep Sol from knowing that you found the trace.
actions.result_text: You erase the visible trace and keep the pattern in memory. When Sol asks whether the relay did anything unusual, you let the rain answer for you.

actions.label: Warn Mara
actions.summary: Give the market's most vulnerable people a chance to prepare.
actions.result_text: You warn Mara. By nightfall, clinic mirrors face the market approaches and every child knows which whistle means run.

actions.label: Preserve it privately
actions.summary: Keep the evidence intact until you understand its value.
actions.result_text: You preserve the trace in your private field record and tell no one. For the first time since waking, you possess something Sol does not know you have.

quests.title: Lines in the Rain
quests.summary: Decide who controls a failing Sprawl feeder when every surviving system can justify its claim.

stages.title: A Block Going Dark
stages.objective: Return to the Rain Market and speak with Mara about the failing municipal feeder.
stages.directive: Find out which lives and systems are competing for the same remaining power.
stages.why: Sprawl sovereignty begins with control of heat, water, medicine, and the machines that keep people alive.

event_transitions.result_text: Mara marks the old switching panel inside the Shuttered Arcade.

stages.title: The Municipal Feeder
stages.objective: Reach the Shuttered Arcade and open the old feeder switching panel.
stages.directive: Map every live draw before deciding which claim is allowed to survive.
stages.why: The feeder can reveal whether the shortage is natural, stolen, or deliberately engineered.

actions.label: Open the feeder panel
actions.summary: Trace the clinic, market, and Collector draws through the failing municipal bus.
actions.result_text: You open the corroded panel and follow three live circuits: Mara's clinic, the public pumps and cold lockers, and a heavy unregistered draw feeding the Collector bay.

stages.title: Who Gets the Current
stages.objective: Choose how the surviving feeder capacity is distributed across the block.
stages.directive: Assign the current knowing that every choice creates a visible winner, cost, and witness.
stages.why: The market will judge the lamps that stay lit, the clinic that opens, and the machines you chose to feed.

actions.label: Keep the Collector breathing
actions.summary: Give Sol the stable draw he requested and let the market rotate through outages.
actions.result_text: You lock the unregistered line at full draw. The Collector settles into a deep mechanical rhythm while half the market lamps die.

actions.label: Prioritize the clinic and pumps
actions.summary: Throttle the Collector so medicine, water, and cold storage remain stable.
actions.result_text: You cut the Collector to a narrow reserve and bring the clinic lamps, public pumps, and cold lockers back to steady power.

actions.label: Expose the hidden siphon first
actions.summary: Keep the block unstable long enough to identify who disguised the Collector draw as public loss.
actions.result_text: You pulse each circuit and expose a second hidden tap nested inside the Collector line. Someone engineered the shortage to look like ordinary Sprawl decay.

actions.label: Restore the public rotation
actions.summary: Reject every private priority and return the feeder to a transparent block-wide schedule.
actions.result_text: You break the private locks and restore the old municipal rotation. No system receives everything, but no one can hide what it takes.

quests.title: The Quiet Ledger
quests.summary: Recover a record of overlapping protection claims and decide whether evidence protects its source or prices them for retaliation.

stages.title: A Tally Without a Name
stages.objective: Find Ilya Renn on Salvage Row and ask why someone tracked the block power decision.
stages.directive: Learn who has been recording protection payments and watcher routes.
stages.why: Names can protect people, expose them, or become another form of control depending on who holds the list.

event_transitions.result_text: Ilya identifies a concealed cache beneath the east salvage scale.

stages.title: The East Scale Cache
stages.objective: Open the concealed cache beneath the east salvage scale.
stages.directive: Recover the ledger before the protection crews notice the cache has been identified.
stages.why: The ledger links ordinary barter debts, a faded Faux Forsaken mark, and surveillance around the Collector.

actions.label: Open the east scale cache
actions.summary: Lift the false weighing plate and recover the sealed tally sleeve.
actions.result_text: The scale plate releases. Inside, waterproof strips map overlapping protection fees, clinic shortages, and three watcher paths converging on the Intake Concourse.

stages.title: Who Carries the Names
stages.objective: Speak with Ilya, then decide what happens to the protection ledger and its source.
stages.directive: Choose whether the ledger becomes shelter, leverage, public evidence, or private insurance.
stages.why: The ledger can prove exploitation and cooperation alike; whoever controls it controls the story those names tell.

actions.label: Shield the source
actions.summary: Move the real evidence trail and leave a false cache for anyone hunting the recorder.
actions.result_text: You separate the names from the payment pattern and seed a false route through the salvage bins. The evidence survives without pointing cleanly back to its source.

actions.label: Force out the names
actions.summary: Use the ledger chain to identify the collectors and give Sol an immediate target list.
actions.result_text: You make Ilya reconstruct the missing names, then carry the sealed list toward Sol. The crews may move faster now—but so can he.

actions.label: Post the overlapping claims
actions.summary: Expose the protection system under the market awnings so no crew can deny charging the same block twice.
actions.result_text: You copy the payment pattern onto the dead route boards. By the time the rain reaches the ink, the entire market knows which crews sold the same promise twice.

actions.label: Keep the ledger private
actions.summary: Preserve the complete record until you understand why its watcher routes converge on the Collector.
actions.result_text: You reseal the tally sleeve inside your coat. Ilya gives you no blessing, only the exact look of someone deciding whether secrecy is protection or ownership.

quests.title: The Wrong Date
quests.summary: Inspect a Collector checksum Sol calls harmless and decide who learns that your reconstruction predates his story.

stages.title: A Harmless Timestamp
stages.objective: Return to the Intake Concourse and ask Sol about the awakened Collector diagnostic.
stages.directive: Hear Sol explain the log before touching evidence tied to your own reconstruction.
stages.why: Sol’s story can be tested against the Collector’s date and the record it tried to erase.

event_transitions.result_text: Sol leaves the heat-curled checksum strip exposed beside the Collector cradle.

stages.title: The Reconstruction Log
stages.objective: Interact with the Recall/Collector and preserve the diagnostic strip before clearing it.
stages.directive: Read both timestamps and determine whether Sol's explanation can be true.
stages.why: The date lies directly in your path, ensuring every class can uncover the contradiction.

actions.label: Preserve the checksum strip
actions.summary: Lift the diagnostic foil before the Collector overwrites its oldest reconstruction entry.
actions.result_text: The strip prints two dates. The older entry carries your reconstruction signature and predates the night Sol says he found the machine by three days.

stages.title: What the Date Changes
stages.objective: Decide what to do with proof that Sol's account of finding the Collector cannot be complete.
stages.directive: Choose who controls the first durable contradiction in the story of your second life.
stages.why: What you do with the date will change who trusts you and who controls the next move.

actions.label: Confront Sol with the date
actions.summary: Show him the strip and demand an explanation while the Collector is still open.
actions.result_text: You hold the strip beside Sol's glove. He reads the date once and says, ‘Then someone reached the machine before either of us.’ He does not explain how your signature was already there.

actions.label: Hide the checksum sliver
actions.summary: Keep the physical contradiction where neither Sol nor the market can rewrite it.
actions.result_text: You fold the sliver behind the lining of your field coat. Sol watches the empty printer slot and chooses not to ask what you removed.

actions.label: Give Mara a copy
actions.summary: Make sure Sol is not the only person who knows the reconstruction date.
actions.result_text: You press the checksum into Mara’s clinic ledger. She compares it to the storm cycle and says only, ‘He knew where to wait before he says he found you.’

actions.label: Erase the strip, keep the date
actions.summary: Appear to follow Sol's request while preserving the contradiction in memory.
actions.result_text: You feed the strip back into the heater and watch the numbers blacken. Sol relaxes a fraction too early; the impossible date is already fixed in your memory.

quests.title: Marked Before Waking
quests.summary: Follow a pre-intake route tag that suggests someone selected your reconstruction before Sol claims the Collector was found.

stages.title: A Route With Your Name
stages.objective: Explore east of the Tram Cut and search the Flooded Platform for the route trace connected to your reconstruction signature.
stages.directive: Follow the second contradiction beyond the public map.
stages.why: The flooded route holds evidence that remains valuable whenever you discover it; careful exploration will not be wasted.

event_transitions.result_text: The optical tag carries your reconstruction signature and a routing time from before your awakening.

stages.title: Selected Before Intake
stages.objective: Take the pre-intake subject marker and interact with it to decode the routing fields.
stages.directive: Determine whether the marker was prepared for a place—or for you.
stages.why: Your recovered instincts help you understand the marker, but it grants no allegiance or new power.

actions.label: Decode the subject marker
actions.summary: Read the hidden routing layer tied to your reconstruction signature.
actions.result_text: Heat from your thumb reveals a response profile matching your recovered class instincts. The tag was not waiting for any survivor; it was waiting for the kind of survivor you became.

stages.title: Who Holds the Second Contradiction
stages.objective: Return to the Rain Market and decide who should control the pre-intake marker.
stages.directive: Choose whether the evidence becomes trust, testimony, distributed memory, or private leverage.
stages.why: The marker can become leverage, warning, or silence. People will remember who received it.

actions.label: Give the marker to Sol
actions.summary: Make the person who controlled your Collector access answer for the second contradiction.
actions.result_text: Sol accepts the marker with both hands. His first question is not where you found it, but whether anyone copied it.

actions.label: Give Mara a clinic copy
actions.summary: Put the timestamp into a record built to survive disputed authority.
actions.result_text: Mara seals the marker beneath a clinic slate and writes its date into three patient tallies. The evidence now has witnesses who owe Sol nothing.

actions.label: Let Ilya distribute the marker
actions.summary: Encode the evidence across ordinary barter records.
actions.result_text: Ilya separates the marker number, time, and route into unrelated tallies. No single strip is dangerous; together they preserve the whole contradiction.

actions.label: Keep the marker private
actions.summary: Preserve the second contradiction where no local relationship can compromise it.
actions.result_text: You seal the marker inside your coat lining. The Rain Market receives no new rumor, and Sol receives no warning that you found another impossible date.

quests.title: The Trial Route
quests.summary: Cross a route that has been prepared to measure you, survive or bypass its sentinel, and decide what to do with the watcher’s apparatus.

stages.title: A Test With Teeth
stages.objective: Reach the Signal Yard. Defeat the tethered route sentinel or search for the emergency cut-line, then withdraw north.
stages.directive: Cross the measured lane without giving the watcher a clean result.
stages.why: You can survive the route by force or by finding the path its designers missed.

event_transitions.result_text: The sentinel collapses, but the recorder above continues blinking. The machine was only the instrument; the test is in the nest.
The cut-line ruins the watcher’s clean measurement and opens a withdrawal lane toward the recorder nest.

stages.title: The Pattern Board
stages.objective: Reach the Watcher Nest and interact with the recorder table and route map.
stages.directive: Reconstruct what the trial was designed to measure.
stages.why: The rig proves someone has been measuring your choices—obedience, protection, investigation, and refusal.

actions.label: Reconstruct the trial pattern
actions.summary: Compare the measured lanes with your prior choices and Collector response profile.
actions.result_text: The board sorts your actions into four branches: obey, protect, investigate, refuse. Every path ends at the same notation—SUBJECT REMAINS VIABLE. The encounter was staged to learn how you choose under pressure.

stages.title: Control the Watcher’s Instrument
stages.objective: Decide what to do with the recorder and route-test apparatus.
stages.directive: Choose whether the watcher loses the instrument, the evidence, the truth, or the reliability of the data.
stages.why: Keep, reveal, or destroy the rig’s record; each answer changes who holds leverage.

actions.label: Destroy the trial rig
actions.summary: End the watcher’s measurements permanently.
actions.result_text: You drive the recorder through the smoked glass. Its final pulse reports an impossible impact, then the measured lanes go blind.

actions.label: Preserve the rig as evidence
actions.summary: Remove its power and keep its measurements intact.
actions.result_text: You pull the power cell without disturbing the recorder slivers. The test can no longer continue, but its authorship marks remain readable.

actions.label: Feed the rig a false pattern
actions.summary: Loop a believable obedience trace through the watcher’s recorder.
actions.result_text: You splice the recorder into a closed movement loop. Somewhere beyond the rain, the watcher sees a compliant subject repeating the same safe choice forever.

actions.label: Tell Sol about the rig
actions.summary: Make Sol respond to the fact that your danger was purchased and measured.
actions.result_text: Sol arrives with clean tools and removes the recorder without touching the route map. “Whoever did this understands Collectors,” he says. He does not say how he knows which fastener hides the memory sliver.

quests.title: Before the Door Closes
quests.summary: Turn suspicion into practical readiness: establish a witness plan, prepare a field cache, map a second exit, and choose how you will meet the unknown confrontation.

stages.title: Someone Must Remember
stages.objective: Return to the Rain Market and choose how the evidence survives if you do not.
stages.directive: Build a witness plan before the watcher changes the board.
stages.why: A trusted witness can keep hard-won information alive—or place it in greater danger.

actions.label: Use Mara’s clinic chain
actions.summary: Leave a timed clinic record that opens if you disappear.
actions.result_text: Mara seals the contradictions beside an ordinary patient ledger. If you fail to return, the record moves to three households before dawn.

actions.label: Use Ilya’s distributed ledger
actions.summary: Split the evidence across harmless-looking barter records.
actions.result_text: Ilya divides the pattern among debts, clinic marks, and route numbers. Anyone seizing one piece learns nothing; anyone trusted with the key can reconstruct everything.

actions.label: Make Sol the witness
actions.summary: Tell Sol that your evidence will name him if you disappear.
actions.result_text: You tell Sol that the pattern now exists in a sealed account and that his name opens it. He smiles without warmth. “Then we both have reasons to keep you alive.”

actions.label: Seal a private account
actions.summary: Trust no local intermediary; leave a timed record only you can cancel.
actions.result_text: You encode the three contradictions into a route sequence and hide the key separately. The account is weaker without a person, but no person can bargain it away.

stages.title: What Survives the First Blow
stages.objective: Return to the Watcher Nest and interact with the dry wall cavity to prepare emergency supplies outside the Collector.
stages.directive: Build a recovery cache no one controls for you.
stages.why: A stocked cache can keep you alive, restore damaged gear, and protect your evidence when the confrontation begins.

actions.label: Build the survival cache
actions.summary: Store trauma and repair supplies beyond the Collector’s control.
actions.result_text: You line the dry cavity with route-map plastic, mark it with the market warning rhythm, and reserve enough space for evidence that must survive you.

stages.title: A Second Exit
stages.objective: Explore east into the Drain Sluice and search for a route that bypasses the measured signal yard.
stages.directive: Never enter a confrontation with only the exit your opponent expects.
stages.why: A second exit gives you a real way out if the Intake Concourse becomes a trap.

event_transitions.result_text: The hidden crawlspace reconnects to the market pump line without crossing the trial yard.

stages.title: Mark the Route
stages.objective: Interact with the sluice handholds to preserve the route without exposing it from outside.
stages.directive: Turn discovery into a route you can use under pressure.
stages.why: Knowing the route is not enough; marking and clearing it makes the escape usable under pressure.

actions.label: Confirm the second exit
actions.summary: Mark the hidden turns from inside the crawlspace.

actions.summary: Make the truth survive even if you cannot win the confrontation cleanly.
actions.result_text: You arrange every preparation around one condition: the pattern must escape the room even if you do not. Victory can be disputed; preserved evidence cannot.

actions.label: Protect the Sprawl first
actions.summary: Keep the coming conflict away from the market and clinic.
actions.result_text: You choose the relay and abandoned routes as the only acceptable battlefield. The Sprawl sheltered your second life; it will not pay for the truth you uncover.

actions.label: Prepare false obedience
actions.summary: Let the watcher believe the tests are still shaping you.
actions.result_text: You rehearse the response the pattern board expects and reserve the real decision for the moment the door closes. Obedience becomes camouflage, not surrender.

quests.title: Instinct Under Pressure
quests.summary: Prove that class identity, equipment judgment, and tactical choice work together before the confrontation Sol has been preparing.

quests.title: Partner in the Field
quests.summary: Define Sol’s combat role, cross the first open route, and learn how a two-person formation survives Sprawl 15.

stages.title: Partner in the Field
stages.objective: Speak with Sol and choose how he should support your formation.
stages.directive: Set Sol’s field order before leaving the Intake Concourse.
stages.why: The order changes his attack and interception behavior but never transfers control of your character.

actions.label: Balanced formation
actions.summary: Sol attacks and shares part of incoming pressure.
actions.result_text: You choose a balanced line: neither fighter becomes the other’s shield.

actions.label: Guard formation
actions.summary: Sol sacrifices some offense to intercept more pressure.
actions.result_text: You tell Sol to guard the opening without taking ownership of the fight.

actions.label: Assault formation
actions.summary: Sol commits harder to the shared target and intercepts less.
actions.result_text: You order a fast two-person press, with a clear signal to break contact if the route changes.

stages.title: The First Open Route
stages.objective: Reach the clinic rooftop above the Rain Market.
stages.directive: Move through the Rain Market and climb to the clinic roof.
stages.why: A contained route teaches navigation before the district opens into several connected loops.

event_transitions.result_text: The rooftop opens the scale of Sprawl 15 just as a rain-slick predator turns toward the clinic cisterns.

stages.title: Two People in One Line
stages.objective: Defeat the roof stalker with Sol active beside you.
stages.directive: Attack the roof stalker and observe Sol’s answering strike or interception.
stages.why: The partner system should be learned through a real but forgiving field threat.

event_transitions.result_text: Sol follows your commitment instead of waiting outside the combat. The clinic roof is secure.

stages.title: The Formation Is Yours
stages.objective: Record what the first fight taught you.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT PARTNER REPORT to close the drill.
stages.why: Recording the lesson turns one successful fight into a rule you can use later.

actions.label: Record the field report
actions.summary: Confirm that Sol fought under your order and developed beside you.
actions.result_text: You record the formation as a partnership: shared danger, visible orders, and no ownership disguised as help.

quests.title: The Price of Shelter
quests.summary: Follow the bridge and caravan route, separate visible service from coercive ownership, and decide how Sprawl 15 should remember protection.

stages.title: Names Beneath the Paint
stages.objective: Cross to the Tenement Bridge and inspect the repair names beneath its planks.
stages.directive: Follow the bridge north of the clinic roof and read who repaired the crossing.
stages.why: In Sprawl 15, a repair name can prove service; a crew mark can turn that same service into a debt.

actions.label: Read the repair names
actions.summary: Compare the family names under each plank with the crew mark painted across the finished repair.
actions.result_text: Three families signed the replacement planks. A faded Faux Forsaken notch cuts across every name and claims the whole crossing. The labor and the threat survive in the same strip of paint.

stages.title: Three Marks, One Cart
stages.objective: Reach the Caravan Steps and inspect the overlapping protection marks.
stages.directive: Continue east and trace what each mark demands from the next supply cart.
stages.why: A promise of safety becomes coercion when several crews sell ownership of the same road.

actions.label: Trace the protection marks
actions.summary: Read the layers in order and determine whether any crew can prove what it protected.
actions.result_text: All three marks demand payment from the same cart. One promises an escort, one threatens delay, and the oldest simply assumes ownership. None names the person who repaired the road.

stages.title: Protection or Ownership
stages.objective: Choose how the bridge and caravan route should record protection before the next cart arrives.
stages.directive: Set a visible rule that preserves shelter without pretending any crew owns the people using it.
stages.why: The route needs help now, but the record you leave will decide whether help becomes service, secrecy, or another claim of control.

actions.label: Post a shared tally
actions.summary: List every repair hand and every protection claim together where the block can compare them.
actions.result_text: You copy the repair names beside the three crew marks. A claim can stay on the route, but it can no longer erase the people who did the work.

actions.label: Protect a neutral passage
actions.summary: Reserve one lane for escorted movement without letting any crew claim the carts that use it.
actions.result_text: You carry a neutral stripe from the bridge rail to one caravan awning. The mark promises passage through the block and nothing more.

actions.label: Require witness marks
actions.summary: Pair every payment with a date and witness so real service and duplicate claims leave different evidence.
actions.result_text: You cut dated witness notches beside the existing sigils. Crews may still charge for protection, but a second claim now exposes itself.

quests.title: Water Is a Border
quests.summary: Trace a hidden water bypass, survive the cistern shelf, and decide who controls a resource the entire Sprawl needs.

stages.title: Water Is a Border
stages.objective: Speak with Mara about the falling public pressure.
stages.directive: Learn why the water exchange has become a political boundary.
stages.why: The Sprawl’s survival economy makes resource routing a sovereignty decision rather than a simple switch puzzle.

actions.label: Protect the public trough
actions.summary: Prioritize a route every resident can audit.
actions.result_text: You agree to trace the bypass with the public tally as the baseline.

actions.label: Protect the clinic reserve
actions.summary: Keep enough pressure for medicine and emergency care.
actions.result_text: You agree that the clinic cannot serve anyone if its cold lockers fail.

actions.label: Expose the hidden route first
actions.summary: Preserve proof before changing a system someone is watching.
actions.result_text: You agree to document the bypass before anyone can rewrite the pressure history.

stages.title: The Second Needle
stages.objective: Reach the water exchange and uncover the concealed bypass.
stages.directive: Search the water exchange pressure meter.
stages.why: Reading the environment shows that routes and resources carry evidence of earlier decisions.

event_transitions.result_text: The concealed needle confirms that a protected tank has been taking public pressure before every shortage.

stages.title: Pressure Has a Guard
stages.objective: Defeat the raider controlling the intake shelf.
stages.directive: Descend through the cistern walk and clear the pump shelf.
stages.why: Combat difficulty rises while Sol’s formation order remains relevant.

event_transitions.result_text: The stolen seals and open controls prove the shortage was managed, not accidental.

stages.title: Who Drinks Tomorrow
stages.objective: Choose how to resolve the bypass.
stages.directive: Select a public, clinic-first, or evidence-first resolution.
stages.why: Equivalent progression keeps sovereignty choices meaningful without hiding a superior reward.

actions.label: Open the public line
actions.summary: Restore the trough first and publish the pressure schedule.
actions.result_text: You open the public line and post a visible rotation so no protected tank can disappear inside the shortage.

actions.label: Stabilize the clinic reserve
actions.summary: Guarantee emergency pressure, then rotate the remaining supply publicly.
actions.result_text: You secure the clinic minimum and publish every remaining ration interval beside it.

actions.label: Lock the evidence chain
actions.summary: Preserve the bypass history while a temporary manual line serves the trough.
actions.result_text: You isolate the hidden line, copy its timing record, and keep a manual public feed running while the evidence travels.

stages.title: A Border Rewritten
stages.objective: Report the outcome from the Rain Market.
stages.directive: Return to Mara and interact with the public water report.
stages.why: The loop ends where its consequences become visible to ordinary residents.

actions.label: Post the water report
actions.summary: Make the pressure decision legible to the people living with it.
actions.result_text: You add the bypass, pressure limits, and chosen priority to the public tally. No one has to trust a private explanation.

quests.title: Sprawl Tradecraft
quests.summary: Clear the old foundry, recover a usable lattice, and make repair work visible instead of letting ownership vanish into the next failure.

stages.title: Sprawl Tradecraft
stages.objective: Speak with Ilya about the old foundry.
stages.directive: Take a repair assignment that ties economy, salvage, and accountability together.
stages.why: A beginner should understand that useful items come from routes and decisions, not only drops.

actions.label: Take the marked repair
actions.summary: Clear the foundry and return the work with a traceable maker’s mark.
actions.result_text: You agree that the repair must remain useful after the person who made it leaves.

stages.title: The Old Ownership Routine
stages.objective: Defeat the misbound foundry hound.
stages.directive: Travel north from Salvage Row and clear the old furnace hall.
stages.why: The route connects combat to an immediately useful workshop rather than an isolated arena.

event_transitions.result_text: The frame’s lattice survives the fight, and the repair benches are safe to use.

stages.title: A Maker’s Mark
stages.objective: Use the old foundry to complete traceable repair work.
stages.directive: Interact with the marked repair bench.
stages.why: The repair teaches facility awareness and prepares you for deeper crafting without forcing a brittle material gate.

actions.label: Complete the marked repair
actions.summary: Rebuild a pump collar and place your maker mark beside Ilya’s.
actions.result_text: You rebuild the collar from recovered lattice and foundry scrap, then mark the work where future hands can see who made it.

stages.title: Useful After You Leave
stages.objective: Return the repair record to Ilya.
stages.directive: Interact with Ilya’s finished-work tally at Salvage Row.
stages.why: Closing the economic loop makes crafting part of the world’s social fabric.

actions.label: Record the finished work
actions.summary: Add materials, maker, and intended use to the public repair tally.
actions.result_text: The repair enters circulation with its history intact. Ilya pays for work the Sprawl can trust twice.

quests.title: The Last Patrol
quests.summary: Complete one integrated circuit of Sprawl 15 with Sol before the Collector confrontation changes the partnership.

stages.title: The Last Patrol
stages.objective: Speak with Sol before beginning the full Sprawl circuit.
stages.directive: Commit to one final patrol through the systems you learned.
stages.why: The milestone rehearses the full beginner loop before the capstone removes Sol from the formation.

actions.label: Begin the full circuit
actions.summary: Patrol water, foundry, watch, and switchyard with Sol.
actions.result_text: You begin the circuit with a clear rule: Sol fights beside you until the patrol is complete, and the Collector waits.

stages.title: Water Line
stages.objective: Reach the water exchange and confirm the public line.
stages.directive: Move to the Water Exchange.
stages.why: The route revisits an earlier decision so the world feels connected rather than disposable.

event_transitions.result_text: The pressure tally still carries your decision, and the patrol moves on before a shortage can become an ambush.

stages.title: Repair Line
stages.objective: Reach the old foundry and confirm the marked repair.
stages.directive: Move to the Old Foundry.
stages.why: The circuit rehearses route planning across the expanded district.

event_transitions.result_text: The marked repair remains in service. Ilya’s apprentices can trace every replacement part.

stages.title: Collector Line
stages.objective: Reach the Collector Switchyard and uncover the second route.
stages.directive: Move to the switchyard and search its maintenance platform.
stages.why: The final exploration beat reveals evidence that directly prepares the capstone.

event_transitions.result_text: The concealed diagram proves the undercroft was prepared before your awakening. Sol goes quiet, but he does not abandon the patrol.

stages.title: The Free Watch Holds
stages.objective: Close the patrol at the Free Watchpost.
stages.directive: Interact with the complete patrol ledger.
stages.why: The beginner arc ends with evidence of mastery: navigation, combat, partner control, resources, class identity, and preparation.

actions.label: Close the patrol ledger
actions.summary: Record a complete circuit and Sol’s final partner status before the confrontation.
actions.result_text: You close the free-watch circuit with every route checked and every decision visible. Sol has kept pace through the full foundation—leveling, attacking, and taking pressure beside you.

quests.title: The First Unowned Caravan
quests.summary: Return to neutral ground after the candidacy threshold and decide how a medicine caravan can be protected without turning protection into ownership.

stages.title: Neutral Ground After the Threshold
stages.objective: Return to the Outer Route Concourse after recording your candidacy decision.
stages.directive: Carry the threshold answer back to a road no faction owns.
stages.why: A candidacy response matters most when you can still act outside the faction that requested it.

event_transitions.result_text: The neutral board carries a new dispute: medicine, three protection claims, and no agreement about who owns the road.

stages.title: Three Claims on One Road
stages.objective: Inspect the neutral caravan dispute on the Route Concourse board.
stages.directive: Separate cargo, escort, information, and ownership before accepting any duty.
stages.why: Sprawl survival taught that protection can become taxation when terms remain hidden.

actions.label: Read the caravan dispute
actions.summary: Identify the cargo, route, threats, claims, and missing terms before choosing a response.
actions.result_text: The medicine belongs to a neutral clinic. One crew offers armed escort, one sells movement intelligence, and one claims the road itself. None wrote a right of refusal.

stages.title: Protection Without Ownership
stages.objective: Choose one accountable way to help the neutral medicine caravan.
stages.directive: Accept a duty without claiming the people, cargo, or road it protects.
stages.why: This is the first regional proof that sovereignty can survive coordination.

actions.label: Escort without claiming the road
actions.summary: Accept direct danger while leaving the caravan, cargo, and destination independent.
actions.result_text: You sign for danger, not ownership. The escort mark expires when the medicine reaches the neutral clinic.

actions.label: Publish a verified movement report
actions.summary: Give scouts and defenders the same route facts without granting command over the caravan.
actions.result_text: You post a time-bounded movement report with source, destination, threat window, and expiration. Information coordinates defense without becoming a deed of ownership.

actions.label: Rewrite the contract with refusal intact
actions.summary: Make price, duty, failure, and the right to walk away visible before anyone accepts the work.
actions.result_text: You separate payment from possession and add an explicit right of refusal. The caravan may hire protection, but no signature transfers the road or the people using it.

quests.title: The Medicine Must Arrive
quests.summary: Apply the caravan principle in the field, cross a three-claim toll, and end the temporary duty at a neutral clinic.

stages.title: A Wagon Without a Banner
stages.objective: Reach the Neutral Caravan Muster below the Route Concourse.
stages.directive: Meet the clinic wagon without accepting a faction seal.
stages.why: The method chosen on the board must survive contact with an actual road.

event_transitions.result_text: The clinic wagon waits under three unsigned preparation stations. Your earlier choice now becomes a field procedure.

stages.title: Make the Method Visible
stages.objective: Prepare the caravan using the protection doctrine already recorded.
stages.directive: Turn principle into a bounded field procedure.
stages.why: A rule that cannot guide action becomes another slogan used by whoever holds the road.

actions.label: Mark a temporary escort
actions.summary: Prepare direct protection that expires at the clinic boundary.
actions.result_text: You lock the shield rails to the wagon and stamp an expiration at the clinic threshold. The mark grants duty, not possession.

actions.label: Calibrate a bounded report
actions.summary: Publish only the movement facts defenders need, with an expiration.
actions.result_text: You bind the report to the medicine route, threat window, and arrival time. Patient identities and ownership claims remain excluded.

actions.label: Seal accountable terms
actions.summary: Make duty, payment, failure, expiration, and refusal visible.
actions.result_text: You seal a contract that ends at delivery and preserves the clinic’s right to refuse both service and ownership.

stages.title: The Road Tests the Rule

stages.title: Strain Is Not a Culprit
stages.objective: Inspect the aging public cell and its isolation boundary.
stages.directive: Record what the hardware proves and what it cannot prove.
stages.why: A visible constraint must not become an excuse to invent sabotage, donor identity, or medical failure.

actions.label: Inspect the public cell
actions.summary: Confirm bounded strain and clinical isolation without inventing a cause.
actions.result_text: The cell shows age and bounded strain under simultaneous public load. The inspection does not identify a culprit, donor, faction, motive, clinical shortage, or system failure.

stages.title: Put the Costs in Public
stages.objective: Reach the Shaklas Public Capacity Gallery.
stages.directive: Move east to compare methods where their costs are visible.
stages.why: A capacity choice is accountable only when the people using it can see the tradeoff.

event_transitions.result_text: Three panels make the costs of reserve, rotation, and manual fallback visible beside one equal-progression mark.

stages.title: No Free Capacity
stages.objective: Compare the three public-capacity methods.
stages.directive: Name the operational cost of each method before selecting one.
stages.why: Hidden cost turns temporary assistance into surprise failure or quiet coercion.

actions.label: Compare threshold costs
actions.summary: Compare reserve, rotation, and manual fallback without hiding their tradeoffs.
actions.result_text: RESERVE spends the whole public allowance for one window. ROTATE spends timing and coordination. MANUAL spends labor and attention. All preserve the same three public outcomes when performed correctly.

stages.title: Choose the Cost You Can Explain
stages.objective: Select reserve, rotation, or manual fallback.
stages.directive: Choose a temporary method without turning it into permanent policy.
stages.why: Different conditions justify different tools; reward equality prevents a hidden preferred morality.

actions.label: Select temporary reserve
actions.summary: Dedicate the public cell for one bounded review window, then release it.
actions.result_text: You select RESERVE: simple and legible, but it consumes the full public allowance for one bounded window.

actions.label: Select public-function rotation
actions.summary: Sequence privacy, receipt, and return functions through the shared cell.
actions.result_text: You select ROTATE: shared capacity with visible timing and a duty to announce every handoff.

actions.label: Select manual fallback
actions.summary: Use paper privacy, a hand-stamped receipt, and human-readable route markers.
actions.result_text: You select MANUAL FALLBACK: independent of the public cell, but dependent on labor, attention, and visible upkeep.

stages.title: A Method Must Leave a Way Back
stages.objective: Reach the Return-Beacon Walk.
stages.directive: Move east and inspect the route before applying the method.
stages.why: A public threshold is not safe when entry is clear but withdrawal depends on permission.

event_transitions.result_text: Powered beacons and manual markers point toward the same public return gate without tracking a person.

stages.title: Verify the Reversible Route
stages.objective: Verify that the selected method preserves a readable return path.
stages.directive: Check powered and manual markers immediately before application.
stages.why: A fallback becomes trustworthy only when it exists before pressure arrives.

actions.label: Verify the public return route
actions.summary: Confirm a readable route to the public queue under the selected method.
actions.result_text: The powered beacon line and manual markers both reach the public return gate. Neither records identity, diagnosis, or side-street movement.

stages.title: Spend the Chosen Cost
stages.objective: Apply only the selected capacity method.
stages.directive: Keep privacy, receipt, and return available without entering clinical systems.
stages.why: Implementation must match the public choice and its declared cost.

actions.label: Apply temporary reserve
actions.summary: Reserve the public cell for one bounded window and post its release time.
actions.result_text: The public cell is reserved for the bounded window. Privacy, receipt, and return remain active together, and the release time is visible.

actions.label: Apply public-function rotation
actions.summary: Sequence the three public functions with announced handoffs.

actions.label: Apply manual fallback
actions.summary: Use nonpowered privacy, receipt, and route tools.
actions.result_text: Paper privacy, a hand-stamped receipt, and visible route ties preserve the public threshold without drawing on the aging cell.

stages.title: Exercise, Do Not Merely Promise
stages.objective: Walk and test the return route under the applied method.

actions.label: Exercise the return route
actions.summary: Test the public path under the selected capacity method.

stages.title: Reach the Public Gate

stages.title: Three Honest Costs
stages.objective: Compare open repair, shared window, and rest-and-redirect.
stages.directive: Name what each method spends before selecting it.
stages.why: Repair spends materials and interruption; sharing spends continuous access; rest spends convenience.

actions.label: Compare the three stewardship methods
actions.summary: Expose cost, refusal or abort condition, expiration, and fallback for every method.
actions.result_text: Open repair spends declared salvage and a maintenance interval. Shared window spends continuous access. Rest-and-redirect spends electronic convenience. All three preserve the clinical boundary and neutral fallback.

stages.title: Choose Without Claiming
stages.objective: Select open repair, shared window, or rest-and-redirect.
stages.directive: Choose the cost you can state publicly and reverse safely.
stages.why: The three choices should express stewardship doctrine, not hidden progression advantage.

actions.label: Select open public repair
actions.summary: Use declared public salvage, publish the work receipt, verify output, and grant no title.
actions.result_text: You select open public repair. Parts, labor, test, and expiration will be recorded; repairer, payer, and supplier receive no ownership.

actions.label: Select a revocable shared window
actions.summary: Divide one shift visibly, preserve refusal rights, and expire the schedule automatically.
actions.result_text: You select a revocable shared window. Each public function receives less continuous time, every participant may refuse, and the schedule ends after one shift.

actions.label: Select rest and redirect
actions.summary: Let the cell cool while manual public tools and the neutral route carry the shift.
actions.result_text: You select rest and redirect. Electronic convenience pauses while manual privacy, accountable receipt, and the neutral fallback carry the public load.

stages.title: Carry the Terms to Their Failure Point
stages.objective: Reach the Neutral Service Turn.
stages.directive: Move east to verify the method where the fallback begins.

event_transitions.result_text: Manual public tools and the route to the outer steps remain available beside the selected method.

stages.title: Name the Refusal and the End

stages.title: Resolve One Part, Not Every Future

stages.title: Name the Source Without Crowning It

actions.label: Publish the public source line
actions.summary: Record Talin or neutral salvage accurately without granting title, sponsorship, priority, data rights, or clinical authority.
actions.result_text: The public source line records the actual path of the part and the selected consideration or refusal. It creates no plaque, owner, sponsor, priority holder, exclusive data right, or clinical office.

stages.title: Prove the Public Can Continue Without One Name
stages.objective: Exercise the neutral salvage and return fallback.

stages.title: Leave Through the Neutral Service Turn
stages.objective: Reach the Neutral Service Turn.

stages.title: Carry No Sponsor Beyond the Threshold

stages.title: Return the Next Decision to the Queue

event_transitions.result_text: Kessa receives one source line, one method record, a verified refusal stamp, and an exercised independent fallback.

stages.title: Expire the Influence Review

stages.directive: Preserve the source record and return every temporary influence-review permission.

actions.label: Close the supplier-offer ledger
actions.summary: Record the method and source while expiring every temporary review, influence, and fallback permission.
actions.result_text: Kessa records the source line, method, consideration or refusal, clinical separation, and independent fallback. Temporary influence-review authority expires. A copied receipt below the rail now requires its own bounded scope review.

stages.title: A Receipt Without Its Edges

stages.directive: Accept only a bounded review of the copy, its missing context, and its reuse risk.

actions.label: Accept the copied-receipt review
actions.summary: Review one copied public receipt without accepting identity exposure, surveillance, policing, ownership, or continuing reuse authority.
actions.result_text: You accept one bounded receipt-scope review. The public fact remains reviewable; private, clinical, and movement records remain outside it.

stages.title: Return to the Blank Owner Line

event_transitions.result_text: The previous offer is closed; a copied receipt hangs below it without its original edges.

stages.title: Find What Survived the Copy

stages.directive: Move south to the copied record.

event_transitions.result_text: The source and method remain legible. Scope and expiration are visibly missing.

stages.title: Separate Fact, Crop, and Unknown

stages.directive: Record what survived, what was cropped, and what remains unknown.
stages.why: A missing context line proves a damaged record, not motive, faction involvement, or a culprit.

actions.label: Trace the copied receipt
actions.summary: Separate surviving public facts, cropped scope, cropped expiration, private boundaries, and unresolved origin.
actions.result_text: You record one copied receipt, its surviving source and method, its missing scope and expiration, and the unresolved copier without adding a faction or motive.

stages.title: Put Reuse Under Glass
stages.objective: Reach the Public Receipt Scope Desk.
stages.directive: Move east with the traced copy.
stages.why: Minimal, timeboxed, and segmented publication must be comparable before one becomes the default.

event_transitions.result_text: Three equal publication methods make accountability and reuse limits visible.

stages.title: Three Ways to Keep a Public Record Public
stages.objective: Compare minimal, time-limited, and segmented publication.
stages.directive: Preserve transaction accountability while excluding identity, diagnosis, movement history, and permanent surveillance.
stages.why: Public truth does not require every detail to remain active forever or in the same ledger.

actions.label: Compare receipt-scope methods
actions.summary: Compare a minimal digest, one review window, and a segmented public ledger with equal progression.
actions.result_text: You compare three methods. Each preserves the same public transaction fact, private boundary, unknown copier, and authority expiration.

stages.title: Choose How Detail Survives
stages.objective: Select one receipt-scope method.
stages.directive: Choose without creating a hidden reward advantage or inventing a culprit.
stages.why: The choice governs publication discipline, not morality, ownership, policing, or clinical authority.

actions.label: Select a minimal public digest

actions.label: Select a time-limited review copy
actions.summary: Keep the complete public transaction record for one announced review window, then reduce it to the minimal digest.
actions.result_text: You select one visible review window followed by automatic reduction to the minimal public digest.

actions.label: Select a segmented public ledger
actions.summary: Keep public transaction facts reviewable while operational and clinical records stay isolated and unlinked.
actions.result_text: You select a segmented ledger. Public facts remain reviewable without linking identities, routes, or clinical records.

stages.title: Carry the Method to the Public Ledger
stages.objective: Reach the Public Ledger Gate.
stages.directive: Move east with the selected publication method.
stages.why: The method must be tested where public facts and private records separate.

event_transitions.result_text: The public printer, private-boundary seal, and expiration marker are ready.

stages.title: Keep the Public Record Out of Private Lives
stages.objective: Verify that identity, diagnosis, movement history, clinical priority, policing, and private operations remain outside the receipt.
stages.directive: Fail closed if public accountability requires any private or clinical field.
stages.why: A receipt can prove a transaction without becoming a map of the people who relied on it.

actions.label: Verify the private and clinical boundary
actions.summary: Exclude identity, diagnosis, clinical priority, movement history, policing, and private operational notes.
actions.result_text: The public receipt accepts transaction facts only. Private, clinical, movement, and policing fields fail closed.

stages.title: Apply the Bounded Publication
stages.objective: Apply the selected receipt-scope method.
stages.directive: Publish only the fields the verified boundary permits.
stages.why: A chosen policy is not real until the actual public output obeys it.

actions.label: Apply the minimal digest
actions.summary: Publish only the bounded transaction digest.
actions.result_text: The cropped copy is replaced by a minimal public digest with method, source or fallback, consideration or refusal, one-shift scope, and expiration.

actions.label: Apply the time-limited review
actions.summary: Publish the complete public transaction detail for one review window, then reduce it automatically.
actions.result_text: The complete public transaction record opens for one declared review window. Its reduction point is visible before publication.

actions.label: Apply the segmented ledger
actions.summary: Publish transaction facts separately while operational and clinical records remain unlinked.
actions.result_text: The public ledger receives bounded transaction facts. Operational routing and clinical records remain in separate, inaccessible channels.

stages.title: Restore Scope and Expiration
stages.objective: Publish the bounded scope line beside the receipt.
stages.directive: State what the record covers, what it excludes, and when detailed review ends.
stages.why: A source line without scope can become a title; a record without expiration can become permanent influence.

actions.label: Publish the bounded receipt scope
actions.summary: Publish transaction scope, exclusions, and expiration without creating ownership or continuing reuse authority.
actions.result_text: The public record now names its one transaction, immediate source or fallback, consideration or refusal, exclusions, and expiration.

stages.title: Make the Copy Authority End
stages.objective: Exercise the selected expiration, reduction, or separation behavior.
stages.directive: Confirm that no continuing copy, surveillance, sponsorship, or access authority survives the review window.
stages.why: An expiration promise is only meaningful if the system actually reaches the expired state.

actions.label: Exercise receipt expiration
actions.summary: End detailed review as declared and retain only the selected bounded public record.
actions.result_text: The declared review window ends. The detail expires, reduces, or remains segmented exactly as published; no continuing copy authority survives.

stages.title: Return Through the Neutral Turn
stages.objective: Reach the Neutral Service Turn.
stages.directive: Move north from the ledger gate.

event_transitions.result_text: The ledger stays behind while the neutral route remains open.

stages.directive: Move north through the public return route.
stages.why: Receipt-review authority must not follow the temporary reviewer into broader District movement.

event_transitions.result_text: The temporary record-review role is confined to the public service route.

stages.title: Return to the Public Queue

stages.directive: Move east to close the review with Kessa.

event_transitions.result_text: Kessa waits beside the original public ledger for final closure.

stages.title: Let the Receipt Remain Without Following Anyone
stages.objective: Speak with Kessa Noll and close the copied-receipt review.
stages.directive: Keep the bounded public record while expiring every temporary review and copy permission.
stages.why: Accountability should survive the transaction; temporary authority should not survive the task.

actions.label: Close the copied-receipt ledger
actions.summary: Preserve bounded public accountability while expiring review, copy, surveillance, and access authority.

stages.title: A Short Label with a Long Reach
stages.objective: Speak with Kessa Noll about the unsupported public-index label.

actions.label: Accept the bounded public-index appeal

actions.result_text: You accept one bounded appeal of the derived label. The source ledger remains operative; authorship, motive, reliance, harm, and faction involvement remain unknown.

stages.title: Leave the Queue Without Carrying Office
stages.objective: Reach the Shaklas Outer Steps.
stages.directive: Move west along the public route.
stages.why: Appeal authority begins at the record, not over everyone using the queue.

event_transitions.result_text: The queue remains public while the bounded appeal travels toward the source ledger.

stages.title: Follow the Neutral Return Line
stages.objective: Reach the Neutral Service Turn.
stages.directive: Move south without entering a private or clinical route.
stages.why: The correction must remain on the public service path.

event_transitions.result_text: The neutral turn keeps the appeal separate from clinical and private records.

stages.title: Return to the Governing Source
stages.objective: Reach the Public Ledger Gate.
stages.directive: Move south to the bounded receipt source.
stages.why: The index is derived; the source ledger governs what can be corrected.

event_transitions.result_text: The bounded transaction record remains intact and operative.

stages.title: Find the Unsupported Label
stages.objective: Reach the Public Index Board.
stages.directive: Move east to the derived index.
stages.why: The label must be inspected in the place where it can guide future decisions.

event_transitions.result_text: The phrase “sponsored restoration” is visible beside a source pointer that does not support it.

stages.title: Separate the Label from Its Author
stages.objective: Speak with Aven Quill and inspect the public index against the source ledger.
stages.directive: Record the proven mismatch and leave authorship, motive, reliance, harm, and faction involvement unknown.
stages.why: A visible false label is evidence of a contradiction, not proof of a defendant.

actions.label: Inspect the index mismatch
actions.summary: Compare the derived label with the bounded source ledger while preserving every unresolved question.
actions.result_text: You record the unsupported phrase, its source pointer, and the source-ledger contradiction. You do not name an author, motive, faction, reliance event, or injury.

stages.title: Move from Dispute to Remedy
stages.objective: Reach the Public Correction Table.
stages.directive: Move east with the source mismatch preserved.
stages.why: Three remedies must be comparable before one becomes operative.

event_transitions.result_text: Dated annotation, linked corrected edition, and reliance hold are presented under equal terms.

stages.title: Three Ways to Correct Without Erasing
stages.objective: Compare a dated annotation, linked corrected edition, and temporary reliance hold.
stages.directive: Preserve the source, original wording, unknowns, and equal progression across all methods.
stages.why: Correction can restore truth without hiding history or creating a new owner of the record.

actions.label: Compare three equal correction remedies
actions.summary: Review annotation, linked supersession, and reliance hold under the same source facts, unknowns, and authority limits.
actions.result_text: The table shows three equal remedies. None erases the source, identifies a culprit, grants title, or creates permanent correction authority.

stages.title: Choose the Operative Relationship
stages.objective: Select annotation, corrected edition, or reliance hold.
stages.directive: Choose how the unsupported label relates to the preserved source and original line.
stages.why: The method changes public record behavior, not progression value or moral worth.

actions.label: Select a dated correction
actions.summary: Keep the original line visible and attach a dated, source-backed correction.
actions.result_text: You select a dated correction. The original remains auditable; the correction will govern future reading.

actions.label: Select a linked corrected edition
actions.summary: Publish a corrected edition with a stable link to the superseded line and governing source.
actions.result_text: You select a linked corrected edition. The old line remains visible as superseded history.

actions.label: Select a temporary reliance hold
actions.summary: Keep the line visible but non-operative while the bounded source ledger remains authoritative.
actions.result_text: You select a reliance hold. The label remains auditable but cannot guide decisions during the declared review window.

stages.title: Fact, Inference, and Unknown
stages.objective: Verify the source boundary before applying the remedy.
stages.directive: Treat the bounded ledger as fact, the sponsor label as unsupported inference, and authorship, motive, reliance, and harm as unknown.
stages.why: The correction is trustworthy only if it does not solve uncertainty by invention.

chosen_one.label: Read the power-without-title caution
chosen_one.summary: A useful or scarce contribution cannot be promoted into sponsorship, title, or future authority without explicit evidence.
chosen_one.result_text: You separate the value of the restored function from the unsupported claim that its source became a sponsor.

messenger.label: Read the control-without-verdict caution
messenger.summary: A public label can steer a crowd; correction must remove unsupported authority without turning the review into another control channel.
messenger.result_text: You preserve the source record and prevent one compressed phrase from becoming a crowd-control verdict.

boss.label: Read the transaction-without-ownership caution
boss.summary: A waived contribution or closed purchase may establish consideration, but neither creates sponsorship, title, or continuing leverage.
boss.result_text: You keep price, waiver, source, title, and influence as separate ledger fields.

fixer.label: Read the repair-with-versioning caution
fixer.summary: Correct the derived index with provenance, rollback, and a visible source link rather than silently rewriting history.
fixer.result_text: You treat the correction as a versioned repair with an auditable prior state.

zealot.label: Read the repetition-without-truth caution
zealot.summary: A phrase does not become proven through repetition, public placement, or institutional confidence.
zealot.result_text: You refuse to convert repeated wording into faith-backed fact.

devout.label: Read the witness-without-sanctification caution
devout.summary: Witness marks support what they observed; they do not sanctify an unsupported sponsor label or hidden intention.
devout.result_text: You preserve public witness while refusing to make the index sacred or unquestionable.

protector.label: Read the correction-with-exit caution
protector.summary: A protective correction must preserve source access, refusal, appeal, and a clear end to temporary review authority.
protector.result_text: You protect future access without owning the record or the people affected by it.

guide.label: Read the least-harm correction caution
guide.summary: Name the proven mismatch, preserve the source, and avoid accusing an unproven author or motive.
guide.result_text: You choose a bounded correction that reduces harm without manufacturing guilt.

system.label: Read the derived-view caution
system.summary: Treat the index as a derived interface and the bounded ledger as authoritative; do not bridge identities, movements, or clinical systems.
system.result_text: You isolate the derived label from private, movement, and clinical data paths.

engineer.label: Read the provenance-and-rollback caution
engineer.summary: A valid correction names version, source, superseded state, operative status, review window, and rollback behavior.
engineer.result_text: You verify the correction as a reversible, source-backed version transition.

infiltrator.label: Read the label-as-intelligence caution
infiltrator.summary: A sponsor label can become movement or affiliation intelligence; correct it without expanding surveillance or identity linkage.
infiltrator.result_text: You remove unsupported affiliation value without creating a new tracking surface.

sniper.label: Read the exact-scope caution
sniper.summary: Correct the precise unsupported phrase and its operative window; do not widen the claim beyond what the source disproves.
sniper.result_text: You hold the correction to the exact label, source line, and time boundary.

born_assassin.label: Read the fast-hold caution
born_assassin.summary: When a derived label can drive action, suspend its authority quickly while preserving evidence and a route to final review.
born_assassin.result_text: You prevent the unsupported line from directing action without erasing the trail.

soldier.label: Read the index-is-not-an-order caution
soldier.summary: A public index is not an order, sponsor roster, access list, or Commander instrument.
soldier.result_text: You keep the correction outside command, faction, access, and enforcement authority.

medic.label: Read the label-is-not-triage caution
medic.summary: A sponsor label cannot affect diagnosis, treatment, urgency, triage, clinical priority, or who receives care.
medic.result_text: You separate the public correction from every clinical decision and recipient record.

actions.label: Verify the source boundary
actions.summary: Separate the authoritative transaction record, unsupported derived label, and unresolved authorship or consequence.
actions.result_text: You verify that the bounded source ledger governs the correction. The index cannot create sponsorship, title, authority, authorship, motive, reliance, or harm.

stages.title: Apply Only the Selected Remedy
stages.objective: Apply the selected correction method.
stages.directive: Change the index’s operative meaning without rewriting the source or inventing a culprit.
stages.why: A correction must be exact, auditable, and bounded to the proven mismatch.

actions.label: Attach the dated correction
actions.summary: Preserve the original line and attach a source-backed dated correction.
actions.result_text: A dated correction now states that the source ledger supports a contribution, bounded purchase, or neutral salvage—not sponsorship.

actions.label: Create the linked corrected edition
actions.summary: Make the corrected edition operative while retaining a link to the superseded line.
actions.result_text: A corrected index edition replaces the operative sponsor label and links visibly to the superseded wording and source ledger.

actions.label: Apply the bounded reliance hold
actions.summary: Keep the original visible but non-operative while the source ledger remains authoritative.
actions.result_text: The sponsor label is marked non-operative for one review window. The original and source pointer remain visible.

stages.title: Carry the Remedy to the Public Gate
stages.objective: Reach the Public Reliance Gate.
stages.directive: Move north with the source and selected remedy linked.
stages.why: The public must see both what changed and what remains unresolved.

event_transitions.result_text: The version seal and reliance marker are ready for bounded publication.

stages.title: Publish the Correction, Not a Verdict
stages.objective: Publish the selected remedy with source, scope, unknowns, and expiration visible.
stages.directive: Correct the operative label without declaring authorship, motive, faction, reliance, or harm.
stages.why: Public trust requires both correction and a visible boundary on what the correction proves.

actions.label: Publish the bounded correction
actions.summary: Publish the old/new relationship, source pointer, unresolved questions, operative status, and expiration.
actions.result_text: The public index now shows the source-ledger contradiction, selected remedy, unresolved authorship and consequence, and the end of temporary review authority.

stages.title: Prove What the Old Line Can No Longer Do
stages.objective: Exercise the selected remedy’s operative behavior.
stages.directive: Confirm that the original remains auditable while decisions follow the correction, corrected edition, or bounded hold.
stages.why: A correction promise matters only if the system stops the unsupported label from directing action.

actions.label: Exercise the remedy’s operative status
actions.summary: Keep the original visible for audit while preventing the unsupported sponsor label from directing decisions.
actions.result_text: The original line remains visible. Its decision authority now follows the selected correction, supersession, or hold exactly; no sponsor, owner, faction, or command role is created.

stages.title: Leave Correction Authority at the Gate
stages.objective: Return to the Neutral Service Turn.
stages.directive: Move west after the operative test passes.
stages.why: Temporary correction authority must not follow the reviewer into the wider route.

event_transitions.result_text: The correction remains public while the reviewer leaves its authority behind.

quests.title: Anchor the Signal
quests.summary: Separate live tone, copied echo, and local safety pulse while fighting an interceptor that attacks the last detected movement.

stages.objective: Reach the Sound Anchor Tunnel.
stages.directive: Move east after the sightline is stable.
stages.why: The second hard trial tests whether copied information can command movement.

event_transitions.result_text: Three tones repeat as a signal-lag interceptor attacks the last movement it detected.
