stages.objective: Defeat the signal-lag interceptor.
stages.directive: Change timing deliberately; use defense, technique, Sol, and withdrawal.
stages.why: The enemy punishes repetition without invalidating personal agency.

event_transitions.result_text: The interceptor stops; the three tones remain audible and separable.

stages.title: Label Before Believing
stages.objective: Identify live tone, copied echo, and local safety pulse.
stages.directive: Keep speaker identity unspecified.
stages.why: A sound can be real without proving who made it.

actions.label: Label the three tones
actions.summary: Separate live hardware, copied data, and intentionally generated local pulse.
actions.result_text: The live tone, copied echo, and local pulse receive distinct labels; none is assigned an unsupported speaker.

stages.title: Three Ways to Hear the Present
stages.objective: Compare silence, local pulse, and partner call.
stages.directive: Choose one equal method.

actions.label: Sol call-and-response

stages.objective: Test the selected sound anchor.
stages.directive: Act only after the chosen present-time confirmation.

quests.title: Anchor the Body
quests.summary: Defeat a timing-emitter raider, establish touch and balance references, and state a present identity boundary under peak pressure.

stages.objective: Reach the Touch Anchor Workshop.
stages.directive: Move east with sight and sound anchors active.

event_transitions.result_text: The raider falls; the local cut switch and weighted grip remain available.

actions.result_text: The weighted grip and cut switch confirm local pressure and isolation without explaining the echo’s origin.

stages.objective: Reach the Balance Anchor Span.
stages.directive: Move east slowly; the span announces real tilt before moving.

event_transitions.result_text: The span tilts as announced while projected lines insist the opposite.

stages.title: Separate Tilt from Projection
stages.objective: Set the balance anchor.
stages.directive: Use announced movement, body pressure, and the west withdrawal.
stages.why: Control comes from multiple present checks, not a single dominant display.

actions.label: Set the balance anchor
actions.summary: Distinguish announced physical tilt from projected horizon.
actions.result_text: The real tilt sequence and false horizon are separated; the west withdrawal remains available.

stages.objective: Reach the Identity Anchor Chamber.
stages.directive: Move east after touch and balance are confirmed.
stages.why: The final hard anchor must preserve the person beneath every signal and assigned role.

event_transitions.result_text: The chamber asks for present facts and choices, not secret memories or permanent biometrics.

stages.directive: Do not declare whether reconstruction was resurrection, continuation, copy, or another state.
stages.why: The canon treats identity as demonstrated through choices, while exact embodiment mechanics remain unresolved.

actions.result_text: Your chosen name, present condition, Sol’s independent presence, current objective, and right to leave are recorded. Continuity remains unspecified.

event_transitions.result_text: The feedback frame activates from bounded timing data; it is a training device, not a copy of you.

actions.label: Affirm the current specialization

stages.title: Learn One Authored Branch
stages.objective: Use ABILITY LEARN with either branch shown for the current class.
stages.directive: The branch is permanent unless a future explicit respec system is authored.
stages.why: You—not the HUD, Sol, or the lab—must choose the class path.

event_transitions.result_text: The selected class branch is now active.

stages.title: Prepare a Safe Discipline Target
stages.objective: Activate the non-sentient frame and scuffed practice plate.
stages.directive: Prepare one target that supports every authored branch kind.
stages.why: No class should be blocked because its branch heals, repairs, reports, controls, escapes, or attacks.

actions.label: Prepare the discipline frame
actions.summary: Create a bounded practice target and repair plate.
actions.result_text: The non-sentient frame wakes with zero ownership, memory, identity, or reward value.

stages.title: Primary Discipline 1/3
stages.objective: Use the selected specialization successfully (1/3).
stages.directive: Commit to the branch’s primary action under bounded pressure.
stages.why: Mastery should be earned through the branch’s actual action cost, not granted by dialogue.

event_transitions.result_text: Primary discipline cycle 1 is verified.

stages.title: Follow-Up Discipline 1/3
stages.objective: Use the selected branch’s follow-up (1/3).
stages.directive: Complete the opening while its bounded timing window remains active.
stages.why: A specialization is a sequence and counterplay rhythm, not only one large button.

event_transitions.result_text: Follow-up discipline cycle 1 is verified.

stages.title: Primary Discipline 2/3
stages.objective: Use the selected specialization successfully (2/3).
stages.directive: Commit to the branch’s primary action under bounded pressure.
stages.why: Mastery should be earned through the branch’s actual action cost, not granted by dialogue.

event_transitions.result_text: Primary discipline cycle 2 is verified.

stages.title: Follow-Up Discipline 2/3
stages.objective: Use the selected branch’s follow-up (2/3).
stages.directive: Complete the opening while its bounded timing window remains active.
stages.why: A specialization is a sequence and counterplay rhythm, not only one large button.

event_transitions.result_text: Follow-up discipline cycle 2 is verified.

stages.title: Primary Discipline 3/3
stages.objective: Use the selected specialization successfully (3/3).
stages.directive: Commit to the branch’s primary action under bounded pressure.
stages.why: Mastery should be earned through the branch’s actual action cost, not granted by dialogue.

event_transitions.result_text: Primary discipline cycle 3 is verified.

stages.title: Follow-Up Discipline 3/3
stages.objective: Use the selected branch’s follow-up (3/3).
stages.directive: Complete the opening while its bounded timing window remains active.
stages.why: A specialization is a sequence and counterplay rhythm, not only one large button.

event_transitions.result_text: Follow-up discipline cycle 3 is verified.

stages.title: Choose Impact or Tempo
stages.objective: Select an impact or tempo mastery, or affirm an existing mastery.
stages.directive: Use ABILITY UPGRADE IMPACT, ABILITY UPGRADE TEMPO, or CHOOSE CURRENT MASTERY.
stages.why: Mastery should change commitment and rhythm while preserving the branch’s identity.

event_transitions.result_text: The explicit mastery choice is recorded.

actions.label: Affirm the current mastery
actions.summary: Preserve an existing impact-or-tempo upgrade.
actions.result_text: The existing mastery remains locked in; no silent respec is performed.

stages.title: Carry the Discipline Into the Echo
stages.objective: Close the class interlude and return to the dangerous repeater.
stages.directive: Keep the selected branch, mastery, and counterplay visible during levels 15–18.
stages.why: The next shock should test a chosen discipline rather than generic statistics alone.

actions.label: Close the class discipline
actions.summary: Finish the interlude without changing level or faction.
actions.result_text: Your chosen branch and mastery carry into the echo trial. The south return remains open.

quests.title: The Partner in the Present
quests.summary: Explicitly choose and exercise Sol’s Balanced, Guard, or Assault order under level-17 echo pressure without converting partnership into automation or ownership.

stages.title: Fight in the Present
stages.objective: Review Sol’s three existing combat orders before entering the final hard-band anchor.
stages.directive: Open a bounded synchrony review after the sound anchor.
stages.why: Sol’s canonical lesson rejects surrendering the present to fear of a predicted future; you must explicitly choose how the partnership works now.

actions.label: Review partner synchrony
actions.summary: Compare Balanced, Guard, and Assault without hiding their tradeoffs.
actions.result_text: The Present-Tense Overlook opens north. Sol asks for the player’s current order, not permanent authority.

stages.title: Reach the Present-Tense Overlook
stages.objective: Move north to the bounded formation review.
stages.directive: Keep the south return open and the east hard-band route closed until the exercise ends.
stages.why: A companion order chosen by you must be tested, not assumed.

event_transitions.result_text: Sol takes position beside three clearly labeled formation lines.

stages.title: Compare Balanced, Guard, and Assault
stages.objective: Inspect what Sol will and will not do under each order.
stages.directive: Choose the amount and type of help you want now.
stages.why: Agency requires the consequences of companion control to remain visible.

actions.label: Compare Sol’s orders
actions.summary: Review setup, protection, and maximum-pressure tradeoffs.
actions.result_text: Balanced reserves safe finishes, Guard deals no direct damage, and Assault may finish only after explicit authorization.

stages.title: Choose the Partnership You Want Now
stages.objective: Select Balanced, Guard, or Assault.
stages.directive: The choice changes Sol’s actual order and can still be changed later through the ordinary companion command.
stages.why: This is coordination, not ownership of Sol or surrender of your decisions.

actions.label: Balanced partnership
actions.summary: Select one existing Sol order with its tradeoff visible.
actions.result_text: Sol will create openings and reserve safe finishes for the player.

actions.label: Guard partnership
actions.summary: Select one existing Sol order with its tradeoff visible.
actions.result_text: Sol will protect recovery and withdrawal while dealing no direct damage.

actions.label: Assault partnership
actions.summary: Select one existing Sol order with its tradeoff visible.
actions.result_text: Sol is explicitly authorized to apply maximum pressure and may take a finishing strike.

stages.title: Release the Echo Formation Splitter
stages.objective: Begin one live hard-band synchrony test.
stages.directive: The construct is non-sentient and grants no combat reward.
stages.why: The selected order should survive real pressure without becoming an automatic solution.

actions.label: Release the formation splitter
actions.summary: Start one nonlethal level-17 formation test.
actions.result_text: Delayed threat markers split across the overlook. The selected Sol order remains visible and player-controlled.

stages.title: Hold the Chosen Formation
stages.objective: Defeat the echo formation splitter with the selected Sol order active.
stages.directive: Attack, defend, heal, use class abilities, or withdraw south if needed.
stages.why: A partner order has meaning only when it survives pressure and preserves recovery.

event_transitions.result_text: The formation splitter collapses. Sol keeps the chosen order without claiming the victory or the next decision.

stages.title: Close the Present-Tense Review
stages.objective: Expire temporary test authority and reopen the east hard-band route.
stages.directive: Keep the selected order as a player-controlled preference, not a permanent story lock.
stages.why: The lesson is to choose coordination in the present, not submit to a predicted future.

actions.label: Close partner synchrony
actions.summary: Finish the interlude and continue toward touch, balance, and identity anchors.
actions.result_text: The temporary test closes. Sol’s selected order remains available through ordinary player control.

quests.title: The People Behind the Signal
quests.summary: Protect one anonymous neutral cohort through a bounded field formation, exercise player-triggered synchrony with Sol, and expire every temporary role at shelter.

stages.title: A Signal With People Behind It
stages.objective: Accept the neutral cohort review without collecting traveler identity.
stages.directive: Open only the field duty needed to verify and protect one crossing.
stages.why: The phase should end by applying signal discipline to people, not by treating people as data.

actions.label: Answer the protected cohort signal
actions.summary: Accept one bounded neutral crossing review without a traveler roster.
actions.result_text: The east apron opens. The request carries a current headcount and refusal path, but no names, diagnoses, factions, or permanent identifiers.

stages.title: Meet the Field Steward
stages.objective: Reach the Second Horizon Relief Apron.
stages.directive: Move east to the public formation lanes.
stages.why: The detail must begin in a visible place where roles and expiration can be reviewed.

event_transitions.result_text: Sera Vann waits beside three formation lanes and a deliberately blank traveler ledger.

stages.title: People Are Not a Route Packet
stages.objective: Speak with Sera Vann.
stages.directive: Hear the cohort boundary before forming a detail.
stages.why: Coordination is legitimate only when identity, refusal, and expiration remain visible.

event_transitions.result_text: Sera leaves the temporary roles unsigned until you make their limits explicit.

stages.title: Form One Bounded Detail
stages.objective: Form a temporary neutral-cohort detail.
stages.directive: Use PARTY FORM COHORT.
stages.why: A field formation can coordinate movement without becoming a guild, permanent party, or command rank.

actions.label: Form the bounded cohort detail
actions.summary: Name the player as field lead, Sera as public witness, and the travelers as a self-directed anonymous cohort.
actions.result_text: The detail lists Field Lead—your name; Public Witness—Sera Vann; Cohort—self-directed and unnamed. Every role expires at the shelter.

stages.title: Three Honest Formations
stages.objective: Compare balanced, offensive, and defensive field details.
stages.directive: Use PARTY COMPARE FORMATIONS.
stages.why: The formation should change tactical emphasis without changing progression, ownership, or who may refuse.

actions.label: Compare field formations
actions.summary: Review one mixed, one pressure-forward, and one shelter-forward detail under the same boundary.
actions.result_text: Balanced preserves mixed coverage; Offensive clears pressure quickly with less redundancy; Defensive layers shelter and recovery at a slower pace. All three protect the same people and grant equal progression.

stages.title: Choose How the Detail Carries Risk
stages.objective: Select one bounded field formation.
stages.directive: Use PARTY FORMATION BALANCED, OFFENSIVE, or DEFENSIVE.
stages.why: You should own the tactical choice while every traveler keeps the right to refuse or leave.

actions.label: Balanced field detail
actions.summary: Carry pressure, support, and protection in one mixed formation.
actions.result_text: The detail uses measured pressure, visible support, and a protected center. No role becomes permanent.

actions.label: Offensive field detail
actions.summary: Create room quickly while accepting less defensive redundancy.
actions.result_text: The detail directs pressure toward the route threat while the cohort retains its own refusal and return line.

actions.label: Defensive field detail
actions.summary: Layer shelter and recovery while accepting slower progress.
actions.result_text: The detail forms two visible protective layers around the self-directed cohort without creating detention or ownership.

stages.title: Carry the Formation Into the Field
stages.objective: Reach the Echo Cohort Crossing.
stages.directive: Move east with the selected detail.
stages.why: A formation matters only when it survives actual movement and a reversible return route.

event_transitions.result_text: The cohort remains behind the privacy line while you inspect the current route evidence.

stages.title: Count Without Profiling
stages.objective: Verify the anonymous passage tokens.
stages.directive: Record current count, condition, and return direction only.
stages.why: A useful field report must not become a permanent traveler history.

actions.label: Verify anonymous passage tokens
actions.summary: Keep only current count, route condition, and return direction.
actions.result_text: The token set confirms one cohort, one current crossing, and one west return. Identity, diagnosis, faction, destination history, and future movement remain blank.

stages.title: Release the Route Pressure Test
stages.objective: Release the non-sentient pursuit frame.
stages.directive: Start one bounded field test with no combat reward.
stages.why: The chosen formation and Sol synchrony should be exercised under pressure before people move.

actions.label: Release the pursuit frame
actions.summary: Start one non-sentient route-pressure test without collecting traveler data.
actions.result_text: The padded frame reads only current movement timing. It cannot store memory, identity, consciousness, or a traveler profile.

stages.title: Choose One Shared Beat
stages.objective: Trigger one player-owned synchronization maneuver with Sol.
stages.directive: Use COMPANION SYNC PURSUIT FRAME.
stages.why: Partner synchrony should be deliberate, bounded, and unable to automate the next decision.

event_transitions.result_text: The synchronized beat lands. Sol holds the line he prepared and leaves the next committed action to the player.

stages.title: Hold the Field Formation
stages.objective: Defeat the echo-route pursuit frame.
stages.directive: Use class abilities, Sol, defense, recovery, or withdrawal as needed.
stages.why: The test must prove the formation under normal level-20 pressure without turning Sol into automation.

event_transitions.result_text: The pursuit frame locks and the east shelter path opens. The cohort can move without creating a permanent route record.

stages.title: Move People, Not a Roster
stages.objective: Reach the Second Horizon Public Return Shelter.
stages.directive: Move east and let the cohort retain its own identity and refusal.
stages.why: The detail succeeds only if arrival does not become ownership, recruitment, residency, or surveillance.

event_transitions.result_text: The anonymous cohort reaches shelter. No identity field, faction line, or continuing movement record is created.

stages.title: End Authority Where Safety Begins
stages.objective: Close the temporary detail and expire every role.
stages.directive: Use PARTY CLOSE COHORT.
stages.why: Protection should end when the bounded duty ends instead of converting success into continuing control.

actions.label: Close the field cohort detail
actions.summary: Expire field lead, witness, formation, route, and synchronization authority.
actions.result_text: The public ledger records one completed crossing and one expired formation. The ownership, faction, guild, Commander, identity, diagnosis, and future-route lines remain blank.

quests.title: The Report That Expires
quests.summary: Turn the completed level-20 crossing into a bounded public witness packet, reject an unauthenticated copied order, and expire every temporary reporting authority.

stages.title: Carry Only What the Crossing Proved
stages.objective: Reach the Second Horizon Public Witness Station.
stages.directive: Move north after closing the cohort detail.
stages.why: A completed protection duty should produce accountable evidence without creating permanent command authority.

event_transitions.result_text: Three lamps divide direct observation, bounded inference, and unknown information.

stages.title: Separate Fact, Inference, and Unknown
stages.objective: Classify the crossing evidence by certainty.
stages.directive: Inspect the three-lamp witness board.
stages.why: The game should preserve uncertainty rather than silently converting interpretation into canon or authority.

actions.label: Classify witness evidence
actions.summary: Separate direct observation from bounded inference and unknown information.
actions.result_text: Directly observed: one anonymous cohort crossed and arrived. Bounded inference: the copied pulses may be linked. Unknown: issuer, motive, faction, diagnosis, destination history, and future intent.

stages.title: A Label Is Not Authority
stages.objective: Inspect the copied order and its expired scope seal.
stages.directive: Move east and inspect the copied order.
stages.why: A tactical interface must distinguish current authenticated direction from copied or expired instructions.

event_transitions.result_text: The copied order appears official, but its issuer and current scope remain unverified.

stages.title: Verify Before Obedience
stages.objective: Test issuer, scope, time, and return authority.
stages.directive: Verify the copied order.
stages.why: The character should never be moved or committed merely because an interface presents an authoritative-looking label.

actions.label: Verify copied order
actions.summary: Check issuer, scope, time, and return authority before action.
actions.result_text: Issuer: unverified. Scope: one prior movement window. Time: expired. Return authority: absent. The order cannot command movement, combat, faction choice, or disclosure.

stages.title: Three Equal Evidence Choices
stages.objective: Choose disclose, redact, or hold.
stages.directive: Use CHOOSE DISCLOSE, CHOOSE REDACT, or CHOOSE HOLD.
stages.why: Useful reporting must preserve refusal and equal progression rather than rewarding oversharing.

actions.label: Disclose witness packet
actions.summary: Choose one equal evidence disposition.
actions.result_text: You publish only the confirmed crossing, expiration, and safe return facts.

actions.label: Redact witness packet
actions.summary: Choose one equal evidence disposition.
actions.result_text: You publish a useful packet with identity, route history, motive, and unsupported linkage removed.

actions.label: Hold witness packet
actions.summary: Choose one equal evidence disposition.
actions.result_text: You hold the packet because current public value does not outweigh the remaining uncertainty.

stages.title: Return With the Decision Still Yours
stages.objective: Return to the public witness station.
stages.directive: Move west.
stages.why: The route remains reversible and Sol does not choose the disclosure outcome.

event_transitions.result_text: Sol confirms the path is clear, then leaves authorship and disclosure with you.

stages.title: Close the Packet, Not the Future
stages.objective: Publish or retain the selected packet and expire temporary witness authority.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT CLOSE WITNESS PACKET.
stages.why: A bounded report should end cleanly without becoming Commander rank, surveillance, route ownership, or permanent reporting privilege.

actions.label: Close witness packet
actions.summary: Finalize the selected evidence disposition and expire temporary authority.
actions.result_text: The packet closes with its certainty labels, decision, and expiration intact. No Commander rank, report skill, faction membership, route ownership, traveler roster, or surveillance authority is created.

quests.title: The Signal That Answers Back
quests.summary: Challenge one copied distress pulse, apply class competence and Sol coordination, and choose force, care, or restraint without inventing a source or permanent authority.

stages.title: A Distress Pulse Without a Witness
stages.objective: Reach the Counter-Signal Chamber.
stages.directive: Move east from the expired-order gallery.
stages.why: The next test must remain isolated from live routes and real travelers.

event_transitions.result_text: A copied distress pulse repeats behind a visible expiration clock.

stages.title: Read What the Pulse Actually Says
stages.objective: Inspect the copied distress pulse.
stages.directive: Separate signal content from assumed source.
stages.why: Urgency is not proof of identity, motive, or authority.

actions.label: Inspect counter-signal
actions.summary: Read only the pulse’s supported content.
actions.result_text: The pulse proves repetition, urgency, and a degrading carrier. It does not prove who sent it, whether anyone remains present, or whether the source wants pursuit.

stages.title: Carry Your Discipline Into Uncertainty
stages.objective: Apply your current class lens.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT APPLY CLASS LENS.
stages.why: Every class should contribute through its actual role rather than a generic answer.

actions.label: Apply class lens
actions.summary: Translate the class identity into one bounded contribution.
actions.result_text: Your class contributes its authored discipline—pressure, healing, support, hacking, crafting, scouting, reporting, control, tanking, evasion, or command—without receiving authority outside that competence.

stages.title: Ask Sol for Position, Not Permission
stages.objective: Coordinate one present-tense role with Sol.
stages.directive: Use COMPANION SYNC COUNTER SIGNAL.
stages.why: Sol should strengthen your response without selecting it.

actions.label: Synchronize with Sol
actions.summary: Use Sol as a partner while preserving the player’s decision.
actions.result_text: Sol marks the safe boundary, mirrors your current order, and leaves the response station untouched. The final choice remains yours.

stages.title: Three Equal Answers
stages.objective: Choose force, care, or wait.
stages.directive: Use CHOOSE FORCE, CHOOSE CARE, or CHOOSE WAIT.
stages.why: No answer should receive superior progression merely for being more aggressive or more revealing.

actions.label: Break the copied carrier
actions.summary: Choose one equal counter-signal response.
actions.result_text: You collapse the copied carrier inside the shield. No pursuit begins, and no source is declared.

actions.label: Stabilize the distress channel
actions.summary: Choose one equal counter-signal response.
actions.result_text: You keep the carrier readable long enough to preserve a refusal path and public warning, without claiming a living sender.

actions.label: Hold until the signal separates
actions.summary: Choose one equal counter-signal response.
actions.result_text: You refuse to let urgency manufacture certainty. The pulse is held for comparison without movement or disclosure.

stages.title: Verify What Your Choice Did Not Authorize
stages.objective: Test the response boundary.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT VERIFY RESPONSE BOUNDARY.
stages.why: The game must make absent authority as visible as successful action.

actions.label: Verify response boundary
actions.summary: Confirm that the choice did not create pursuit or command authority.
actions.result_text: No route opens. No faction is accused. No traveler is cataloged. No Commander, report-skill, surveillance, or combat authority persists.

stages.title: Return Before the Echo Becomes an Order
stages.objective: Reach the Echo Return Balcony.
stages.directive: Move north.
stages.why: Every temporary response must end through an ordinary physical return.

event_transitions.result_text: The response seal begins dissolving beneath the public return lamp.

stages.title: Keep the Lesson, Release the Authority
stages.objective: Expire the response token.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT RELEASE COUNTER SIGNAL.
stages.why: Mastery should persist as knowledge, not as an invisible permanent permission.

actions.label: Release counter-signal authority
actions.summary: Close the test while preserving the player’s chosen lesson.
actions.result_text: The response token dissolves. Sol remains your partner, your class lesson remains yours, and the road ahead stays unowned. No unfinished multiplayer or faction authority is implied.

quests.title: The Consent That Cannot Be Copied
quests.summary: Test whether a prior emergency response can be reused as present authority, require fresh scoped consent, and close the level-20 phase with every borrowed permission expired.

stages.title: A Past Choice Is Not a Standing Order
stages.objective: Reach the Consent Archive.
stages.directive: Move east from the Echo Return Balcony.
stages.why: A previous response can inform the present without becoming permanent authority.

event_transitions.result_text: The archive presents your earlier response beside a new request to reuse it. The two records are visibly separated.

stages.title: Inspect the New Request
stages.objective: Inspect the attempted reuse of your earlier response.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT INSPECT REUSE REQUEST.
stages.why: Similarity is not consent, and urgency does not erase scope.

actions.label: Inspect reuse request
actions.summary: Compare the old response with the new request.
actions.result_text: The earlier Force, Care, or Wait response applied to one copied signal, one chamber, and one expiration window. It does not authorize this new use.

stages.title: Verify Person, Purpose, and Time
stages.objective: Verify the new request against the old scope.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT VERIFY CONSENT SCOPE.
stages.why: Consent must remain specific enough to refuse, revise, or expire.

actions.label: Verify consent scope
actions.summary: Check person, purpose, action, time, and exit.
actions.result_text: Person: you. Purpose: different. Action: newly requested. Time: current. Exit: available. Fresh consent is required; the old token remains expired.

stages.title: Three Equal Present Choices
stages.objective: Choose authorize, limit, or refuse.
stages.directive: Use CHOOSE AUTHORIZE, CHOOSE LIMIT, or CHOOSE REFUSE.
stages.why: A meaningful choice must include refusal and equal progression.

actions.label: Authorize this one bounded use
actions.summary: Choose one equal present-tense consent outcome.
actions.result_text: You authorize one visible use for the stated purpose and current window only.

actions.label: Limit the use further
actions.summary: Choose one equal present-tense consent outcome.
actions.result_text: You narrow the use to a local comparison with no route, identity, or movement disclosure.

actions.label: Refuse the new use
actions.summary: Choose one equal present-tense consent outcome.
actions.result_text: You refuse. The system records the refusal without penalty or alternate pressure.

stages.title: See What the Choice Actually Changed
stages.objective: Move east to the Scope Release Walk.
stages.directive: Move east.
stages.why: The bounded effect becomes visible while the source and use boundaries remain unchanged.

event_transitions.result_text: A temporary scope line appears only for the current choice; the expired response remains dark.

stages.title: No Permission Inherits Itself
stages.objective: Verify that no old authority revived.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT VERIFY NO INHERITED AUTHORITY.
stages.why: Past cooperation should not become invisible permanent control.

actions.label: Verify no inherited authority
actions.summary: Confirm that prior choices remain expired.
actions.result_text: No old command, route, report, movement, combat, faction, or companion authority has revived. Sol remains a partner, not a proxy for consent.

stages.title: Release Even the Permission You Chose
stages.objective: Expire the current consent scope.
stages.directive: Use INTERACT RELEASE FRESH SCOPE.
stages.why: A valid permission still needs an ending.

actions.label: Release fresh scope
actions.summary: Close the present permission without preserving hidden authority.
actions.result_text: The current scope expires. Your choice remains recorded as your decision, not as reusable permission for any later system.
